# ExtFn

> Browser extension configuration, runtime, build, scan, and packaging for Chromium and Firefox.

## Documentation

- [CLI workflow](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/cli.md) — Develop, build, scan, and package extension targets.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/configuration.md) — Choose targets, background handlers, page surfaces, and content mounts.
- [Content and background handlers](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/content-and-background.md) — Register multiple content modules and discover background handlers.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/getting-started.md) — Define an extension and run the canonical ExtFn workflow.
- [ExtFn](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/index.md) — Code-first browser extension development for Chromium and Firefox.
- [Integrations and Svelte](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/integrations.md) — Keep domain contracts and host adapters with their owners.
- [Operations and limits](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/operations-and-limits.md) — Supported browser targets, manual steps, and validation boundaries.
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/reference/cli.md) — Develop, build, scan, and package extension targets.
- [Consumer host abstraction](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/reference/consumer-host-abstraction.md) — Move SvelteKit runtime dependencies behind consumer-owned adapters.
- [Reference](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/reference/index.md) — Source-aligned ExtFn guides and examples.
- [Content and background handlers](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/reference/multi-content-and-background-handlers.md) — Multiple content modules, message handlers, ports, and Svelte mounts.
- [Scanner and report](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/reference/scan.md) — Strict scan rules, findings, formats, and packaging behavior.
- [Runtime and browser access](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/runtime.md) — Use the Promise-first browser facade, messaging, events, and capabilities.
- [Scan and package](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/extfn/docs/content/docs/scan-and-package.md) — Interpret strict findings and produce extension archives.
